Container.Name: MultiPlayer-2000
Container.Overview: Self-hosted HLS multi-wall video viewer with local and Microsoft Entra ID sign-in. The image is built locally (see README), so "update available" checks do not apply.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database (users, channels, saved walls) and the session secret.

Config.Name: Admin username
Config.Description: First admin account. Only used the first time the container starts.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: First admin password (8+ characters). Leave blank to have one generated and printed in the container log.

Config.Name: Base URL
Config.Description: Public address, e.g. https://wall.example.com (no trailing slash). Required for Microsoft sign-in and must be https.

Config.Name: Entra tenant ID
Config.Description: Directory (tenant) ID. Leave the three Entra fields blank for local accounts only.

Config.Name: Entra client ID
Config.Description: Application (client) ID of the app registration.

Config.Name: Entra client secret
Config.Description: Client secret VALUE (not the secret ID).

Config.Name: Entra admin emails
Config.Description: Comma-separated emails that become administrators when they sign in with Microsoft.

Config.Name: Entra auto-provision
Config.Description: true: anyone in the tenant can sign in as a viewer. false: only users pre-approved in the admin console.

Config.Name: Entra allowed domains
Config.Description: Comma-separated email domains allowed to sign in. Blank allows the whole tenant.

Config.Name: Local login enabled
Config.Description: Set false to force Microsoft sign-in only. Keep true until SSO is proven to work.

Config.Name: Max panels
Config.Description: Largest number of panels a user can put on their wall (1-36).

Config.Name: App name
Config.Description: Name shown in the header and on the sign-in page.

Config.Name: Seed demo channels
Config.Description: Add three public test streams on first start.
